name: Net, ya ne Bajron...
source:
What lies behind the works of a great writer and poet?
It is time to look a little closer and open a new book — the book of Mikhail Lermontov’s childhood.
His earliest hopes and struggles, his passions and friendships, and even his first love — there is much more to discover than one might expect.
translation:
在一位伟大作家兼诗人的传世佳作背后，究竟隐藏着怎样的人生？
是时候走近一步，翻开一卷崭新的篇章——米哈伊尔·莱蒙托夫的童年之书。
他最初的希冀与挣扎、热忱与友情，乃至懵懂的初恋——等待你去发掘的故事，远比想象中更加丰富动人。
